last_completed_unit.target: Cargo source selection for version-only dependencies without path, git, or alternate registry
last_completed_unit.action: Inspected exactly the official Cargo dependency reference for source-selection semantics.
last_completed_unit.result: Cargo documents crates.io as the default dependency source when only name/version are specified; alternate registry, git, and path sources require explicit corresponding keys. Therefore the already-observed hyperium/hyper-util v0.1.12 system-configuration and windows-registry version-only declarations imply default-registry (crates.io) resolution at manifest-semantics scope. A fresh uncached default path therefore retains package-registry acquisition unless a separate source-replacement or vendored/local configuration is demonstrated.
